concepts.title: Net Force on an Object
concepts.definition: The single resultant force obtained by combining all individual forces acting simultaneously upon a body.
concepts.formula: net_force = abs(force_1 - force_2) or net_force = force_1 + force_2
concepts.key_idea: Forces acting in the common direction reinforce each other, while opposing forces subtract from one another.

concepts.title: Force of Friction
concepts.definition: A contact force operating at the interface between two surfaces that resists their relative motion.
concepts.key_idea: Frictional force operates in opposition to the direction of motion or intended sliding.

concepts.title: Newton's First Law of Motion
concepts.definition: A physical law stating that an object maintains its state of rest or uniform straight-line velocity unless acted upon by a non-zero net force.
concepts.formula: if f_net = 0, then a = 0 and v = constant
concepts.key_idea: In the absence of an unbalanced external force, an object undergoes zero acceleration.

solution_steps.explain: if velocity is zero the object is at rest; if velocity is non-zero it continues in uniform straight-line motion

concepts.title: Newton's Second Law of Motion
concepts.definition: The law stating that the acceleration of a body varies in direct proportion with the net force both applied and in inverse proportion with its mass.
concepts.key_idea: Net applied force produces proportional acceleration in the force's direction.

concepts.title: Acceleration of Connected Mass Systems
concepts.definition: The combined acceleration of multiple connected objects subjected to an external net force.
concepts.key_idea: Connected objects move together with a common acceleration determined by total external force and total system mass.
